title: A Key Exchange Construction using Mihailova Subgroups in Braid groups
summary: In this paper, we propose a modified Anshel-Anshel-Goldfeld (AAG) key exchange construction.The algebraic motivation underlying this construction comes from the membership problem for Mihailova subgroups of the braid group, a problem that is algorithmically unsolvable. We show that this perspective leads naturally to a quotient-group formulation involving Mihailova subgroups modulo the center of Bn.
